script: Chapter 1. Introduction to SEO and the Career Path. SEO helps people find a website and understand it. Every project follows one cycle: audit, research, plan, implement, measure, and report. Then the cycle repeats. You can start as a freelancer, join an agency, work in-house, write SEO content, or move into technical analysis. Most people start as freelancers. Practice: pick three websites and note what each does well for search. Recap: SEO is a repeated cycle, and there are several career paths.
glossary: SEO, search engine optimisation, career path, freelancer, agency
